name: Sport Recife 2017 (Luxemburgo)
scopeNote: Sport Recife under Vanderlei Luxemburgo, from 29 May 2017 (replacing Ney Franco, sacked 24/25 May; Daniel Paulista interim) to 26 Oct 2017 (sacked after 0-2 home loss to Junior Barranquilla in the Sul-Americana quarter-final first leg; Daniel Paulista took over). 34 matches (11W 8D 15L, 40%) per Bahia Noticias and Business Standard: Brasileirao (left at round 30, team 15th), Pernambucano final vs Salgueiro (28 Jun, 2-1 aggregate title), Copa do Brasil/Sul-Americana as applicable. Spell clears the 15-match threshold. Tactical sources are very thin: no tier A-B analysis found; most evidence is press quotes. Sport's own shape, pressing, block, build-up and set pieces are largely undocumented. Luxemburgo's own stated priority was team identity before tactics. Sacking date: Bahia Noticias puts the loss on Thursday 26 Oct; end date 2017-10-26.
openQuestions: Per-competition match count not verified (34 total from two press sources).
Shape (4-4-2 vs other) unverified; only a 2019 retrospective says Diego Souza and Andre often played together up front.
Pressing, block, build-up, width, marking, set pieces: no source found. Gazeta Esportiva, Vavel, Trivela and Lance pages returned 403/404/not-accessible.
Dubeux's stated reason (poor second half in the Brasileirao) vs Luxemburgo's 'mystery' remark: contradictory accounts of the sacking.
Goal.br reported the 2017 Pernambucano title suspended (tapetao) at some point; outcome not checked.
Gap pass run: 3 extra searches (tactics/marking, Pernambucano final, set pieces/pressing) found no accessible tactical source for these axes.

sources.title: Ex-Real Madrid boss Luxemburgo sacked as coach of Brazil's Sport
sources.evidence: After replacing Ney Franco on May 29, Luxemburgo led Sport to 11 wins, eight draws and 15 losses during his five months in charge.

sources.title: Após queda de Luxemburgo, Daniel Paulista assume o comando do Sport
sources.evidence: Ele teve um aproveitamento de 40% com 34 jogos disputados, 11 vitórias, oito empates e 15 derrotas.

sources.evidence: O vice-presidente do Leão pernambucano afirmou que o motivo da saída de Luxa foi o desempenha abaixo do esperado no segundo turno do Campeonato Brasileiro.

sources.title: Após queda de Luxemburgo, Daniel Paulista assume o comando do Sport
sources.evidence: "Aconteceu uma coisa que iria acontecer há três meses. Eu falei para Gustavo (Dubeux, vice-presidente de futebol) que quando acontecesse, ele me demitiria.
